title: Live-Action This World is Worth Fighting For Series Casts Ikoi Hayase
content:
The official website for the live-action series of Hatsumi Kodama 's This World is Worth Fighting For ( Konoyo wa Tatakau Kachi ga Aru ) manga announced on Friday that Ikoi Hayase (live-action Journal with Witch /Worlds Apart, Cursed Meme, Ano Ko wa Daare?) is joining the series' cast. Hayase plays Yūka Kitayama, a teenager who took over running her family's liquor store when her father was unable to bounce back from his wife's death in a hit-and-run accident.

Seven Seas licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Ito Kiri has had enough. She's 25, is in her third year at a company she hates where she's also getting sexually harassed, and dating a shitty guy. She exists solely on energy drinks and one thought: “I want to be useful to others.” But she's beginning to reach her limit and feeling hopeless about her future. That is, until she receives a mysterious letter one day. No return address, no name, just a message she needed: Permission to live freely and on her terms. From that moment, something changes in her and she decides she's doing whatever it takes to live a life worth living. And she's not holding back or pulling any punches.

Hiyori Sakurada stars in the live-action series as Ito Kiri.

Kaede Kamiya is directing the live-action series. Yasuko Kuramitsu is writing the scripts.

The live-action series will premiere on Fuji TV and affiliated channels in January 2027.

Kodama debuted the manga in Shogakukan 's Big Comic Spirits magazine in April 2023, and ended it in October 2025. The fifth and final compiled book volume shipped in Japan on January 30.
author: ANN

title: No Longer Heroine's Momoko Kōda Launches New Manga on December 21
content:
Manga creator Momoko Kōda announced on November 20 that they will launch a new manga titled Kono Oto, Myaku Ari Desu ka? (Is This Sound a Pulse of Interest?) on Shueisha 's Manga Mee web platform on December 21. The manga teases an unlikely romance between a novel-writing (but romantically inexperienced) girl who dreams of her one true love, and a playboy doctor.

Kōda launched the Atashino! (Mine!) manga in Shueisha 's Bessatsu Margaret magazine in September 2017. The manga ended with tis fourth volume in January 2019. The manga inspired a live-action film in 2024.

Kōda's 10-volume No Longer Heroine ( Heroine Shikkaku ) manga ran in Bessatsu Margaret from 2010 to 2013, and inspired a live-action film in September 2015. Yen Press released the manga in English.

Kōda launched the My Special One ( Kimi ga Tokubetsu ) manga in Bessatsu Margaret in March 2019. The manga went on hiatus in October 2022 due to Kōda's poor health, but resumed serialization in June 2024. The series then ended in January 2025. Viz Media publishes the manga in English. The manga was also adapted into a live-action film and live-action television series in June and September last year, respectively.

title: Isekai Affair Writer Masakazu Ooi Launches New Manga
content:
Shogakukan 's online magazine Weekly CoroCoro Comic launched Masakazu Ooi 's new manga Ma Mama Musō~Maō no Mama ni Amae Makuttara Saikyō ni! Saijaku Skill "Amaenbō" de Musōshite Akugyaku Yūsha ni Fukushūshimasu (Ma Mama Musō: Becoming the Strongest by Being Utterly Pampered by the Demon Lord's Mama! Using the Weakest Skill "Spoiled Child" to Become Unrivaled and Take Revenge on the Wicked Hero) on Friday.

The manga centers on Solo, a dull boy who grew up without knowing his mother. He joins his childhood friend, the archetypal hero, on a quest to defeat the Demon Lord, but the hero betrays Solo upon their triumphant return to the kingdom, leaving him in despair. A chance encounter with the Demon Lord's mother activates Solo's "Spoiled Child" skill, and he gains overwhelming power as the Demon Lord's mother thoroughly pampers him. Solo then sets to exact revenge on the hero.

Ooi and artist Inomaru launched the ISEKAI AFFAIR: 10 Years After Defeating the Demon King, the Hero Cheats on His Wife With a Warrior Woman Who Lost Her Husband manga on Shogakukan 's Sunday Webry website in December 2020. The manga's third and final compiled book volume shipped in December 2021. Seven Seas licensed the manga and released the third volume in September 2025.

The duo then launched the Isekai Furin II - Michibikareshi Hitozuma-tachi to Bukiyō Tensei Yūsha ( ISEKAI AFFAIR II: Guided Wives and Clumsy Otherworld Heroes) spinoff manga in November 2021 on Shogakukan 's Sunday Webry website. The manga ended in its ninth and final volume, which published in January 2025.

The duo launched the ongoing Ura Dungeon Oku-san (The Secret Dungeon Wife) manga in Shogakukan 's Monthly Sunday GX magazine in April 2025. Ooi is credited for the original story, and Inomaru is drawing the manga. Shogakukan published the manga's fifth volume on November 18.

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender Creator Breaks Silence on Future Projects: “I’m Working on Something You Don’t Really Want”
content:
The franchise’s co-creator Bryan Konietzko drops a major hint regarding future projects. The fan-favorite Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise keeps expanding as the latest animated series was released after 12 years to explore the unique worldbuilding and the captivating characters. Avatar: Seven Havens premiered in October this year and reached its conclusion in the same month. The first season wrapped up in Episode 13 before confirming that the animation series will return with sequel seasons eventually. While the journey of Pavi and Nisha will continue in Seven Havens , Avatar Studios continues to work on more projects for fans.

In an official Avatar: Braving the Elements podcast hosted by Dante Basco (the voice behind Zuko) and Janet Varney (the voice behind Korra), Konietzko discussed the immense hate Korra received when The Legend of Korra was released. Seven Havens takes place 225 years after The Legend of Korra , but it’s obvious her story is far from over. Humanity not only blames her for the cataclysm, but also fears the Avatars for the powers they possess. While the second season of Seven Havens is expected to answer some burning questions regarding Korra , Konietzko has his own plans when it comes to this overhated character.

Avatar: The Last Airbender Creator Shares His Plans for Future Projects Related to Korra

In a discussion regarding Korra, Konietzko shared, “If you don’t like the series or you don’t like the character, that’s fine. If you don’t like Korra because of misogyny, and just toxic internet garbage, then that’s not fine.”

He also added, “Actually, that’s a problem… You’re not actually an Avatar fan. It’s annoying, but it’s also kind of what comes with any sort of success or popularity. You’re just going to have these kinds of things.” Konietzko also revealed his plans for future projects, “Here’s the thing, I’m already two projects beyond what you’re looking at. I’m working on something that you really don’t want and you are not looking for, that I am so excited about.”

During the podcast, Konietzko didn’t hold back his disappointment regarding the hate Korra has been receiving over the years. He also knows that there’s some level of misogyny that’s tied to the character’s hate, which he is not happy with. Not to mention that Konietzko also doesn’t consider Korra haters the fans of Avatar whose dissatisfaction with the character stems from misogyny rather than the way she is written. While fans are anticipating the return of the second season of Seven Havens , Konietzko confirms working on two more projects that haven’t been announced.

And by the looks of it, both projects will have Korra as a crucial character. The Legend of Korra premiered in 2012 , centering around her life as someone born as Aang’s successor as the Avatar. While her story was a massive hit, she is also one of the most polarizing characters in the series, with many viewers failing to appreciate her growth and character depth. After the recent podcast, it’s evident Konietzko doesn’t plan on holding back when it comes to having Korra at the center of attention for the next several years.

What’s Next for the Avatar: The Last Airbender Franchise?

Seven Havens is the first animated series released since The Legend of Korra wrapped up, but the journey of Pavi and Nisha is far from over. Paramount is already working on a four-season series , which means fans can expect the story to continue for several years. While a second season was confirmed right after the first season’s finale, there haven’t been any updates on the release window. Fans have yet to get the first look at the second season as well, and there’s no telling how long we will have to wait for it.

On the other hand, Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos was confirmed in October this year during the New York Comic Con. This animated series will serve as a prequel following the story of a 14-year-old Avatar Kuruk and his koala-otter companion, Nikik. The story will feature his journey as he rebels against tradition to master the four elements. Much about the series is still unknown, but judging by the premise and the first look revealed during this year’s NYCC, fans can expect another banger from Avatar Studios.

What are your thoughts on Korra, and does she deserve the hate? Or you can head down to the comments to share your expectations for the future projects.

title: 'Ask and You Will Receive' Boys-Love Manga Gets Live-Action Series
content:
MBS announced on Friday that it is producing a live-action series adaptation of Niyama 's Ask and You Will Receive ( Sonna ni Iu Nara Daite Yaru ) manga.

The series will premiere on the "Dramaphil" programming block on the MBS and TV Kanagawa channels on January 21, on TV Saitama on January 25, on Gunma TV on January 26, on Tochigi TV on January 27, and on Chiba TV on January 28.

The cast includes:

One N' Only group member Rei Sawamura ( Happy of the End , Battle King!! -We'll rise again-, Ima Kara, Shnyū Yame yō ka) as Hikaru Omoteya

Ryūdai Onikura ( A Man Who Defies the World of BL , HiGH&Low The Worst X ) as Shinobu Urakawa

Hirokazu Fujisawa and Masahito Namekawa are directing the series, with scripts by Hiroko Kanasugi ( Takumi-kun Series , Mr. Unlucky Has No Choice but to Kiss! , Cosmetic Playlover ). Kōichi Endō is composing the music.

Manga production company ShuCream BL released the manga in English, and it describes the story:

A Casanova who loves one night stands and a beautiful, narcissistic “prince” – a seesaw love driven by irresistible instincts! Shinobu Urakawa is a dull office worker in the daytime, but at night, he turns into a playboy who can seduce any guy with a glance. He's a top enjoying his double life until Hikaru Omoteya, the detestable narcissistic “prince” of the sales department, turns up at his favorite gay bar. Even though Hikaru is straight, he seems to enjoy the bar and keeps coming back, preventing Shinobu from enjoying his usual nightlife. But Shinobu realizes that Hikaru looks interested in him, and decides to use his charm as a weapon to regain his night oasis! “I bet you were actually waiting for me to approach you.” Will the pretty prince be able to resist him?

Niyama launched the manga in the e-book reading service Renta! in August 2019. Takeshobo released the manga's fourth compiled book volume on March 30.

title: Live-Action Darwin's Game Film's Trailer Reveals More Cast
content:
The staff for the live-action film of FLIPFLOPs ' Darwin's Game manga revealed a new trailer and poster visual for the film on Friday. The trailer reveals more cast members for the film.

Idol group Snow Man member Raul will play antagonist Wang (seen above) in the film.

Other new cast members include:

• Gaku Sano (top row center in image above) as Shigu

• Haruse Akune (top row right) as Keiichi

• Hinano Nakayama (top row left) as Sui

• Kōki Maeda (bottom row left) as Shinozuka

• Kentarō Maeda (bottom row center) as Kyouda

The film will star:

• Taishi Nakagawa as Kaname

• Kōki, as Shuka

• Mei Hata as Rain

• Fūju Kamio as Ryūji

• Kōji Yamamoto as Hiiragi

Fumihiko Sori (live-action Fullmetal Alchemist , Tomorrow's Joe films) is directing the film. Hayato Miura is writing the script along with Sori. The film will open in Japan on March 12.

Titan Manga licensed the Darwin's Game manga and will release the series in omnibus volumes. The first omnibus volume will ship on January 12, 2027. Titan Manga describes the story:

Kaname Sudo's life changes forever when he accepts an invitation to Darwin's Game , a mysterious mobile app that thrusts its players into real-life battles using supernatural “Sigils” with terrifying effects. Suddenly hunted by deadly foes, Kaname must outthink and outfight seasoned players as he uncovers the truth behind the game... and the shadowy organization controlling it.

The manga launched in Bessatsu Shōnen Champion magazine in December 2012. Shū Miyama (formerly known under the pen name Ginko) provides the story for the manga, while Yuki Takahata provides the art. The manga ended in October 2023, with an epilogue chapter published the next month.

The manga inspired a television anime that premiered with a one-hour episode in January 2020. FunimationNow streamed the series as it aired. The anime debuted on Crunchyroll and HIDIVE in February 2020.

The Darwin's Game ~Flag Game~ spinoff novel has a manga adaptation that launched in Akita Shoten 's Bessatsu Shōnen Champion magazine on November 13. Guuno is drawing the manga.

title: New Dark Vampire Fantasy Sets 2027 Release Date With Epic Trailer – Watch Now
content:
Vampires have been making a major comeback in popular media in recent years, with films, games, and anime reinventing the nocturnal blood-suckers to bring them back into the limelight. 2027 is ramping up to be a big year for the gothic creatures, with vampire-themed anime like Otaku Vampire’s Love Bite and The Record of a Fallen Vampire set to release throughout the year. Joining them is a brand-new series from Studio Teddy, the anime adaptation of Mercedes and the Waning Moon , an original series by Firehead that marries the concepts of isekai adventure with the romantic appeal of vampirism.

Mercedes and the Waning Moon is a unique spin on the isekai genre, taking a disgruntled, unnamed reincarnated individual and giving them a second chance at life as a vampire named Mercedes Grunewald, a descendant of vampire nobility forced to live in the countryside with her mother due to bad blood between her father. Unsure of her future or position in their house’s line of succession, Mercedes instead becomes a professional dungeon crawler. In anticipation for the anime’s January release and kicking off the new year, the anime adaptation revealed a stunning new trailer and promotional art you can find below.

Mercedes and the Waning Moon Promises Vampiric Romanticism With Isekai Adventure

The newly revealed trailer and key visual for Mercedes and the Waning Room depicts the titular Mercedes wielding her signature battle axe while surrounded by shattered glass teasing other characters that appear throughout the series. The main voice cast for the anime was also shared, which includes a star-studded cast consisting of Anna Nagase (Akane in Akane-banashi ) as Mercedes, Kenta Miyake (All Might in My Hero Academia ) as Benkei, Ryunosuke Watanuki (Okuhito in Blue Lock ) as Kuro, Junichi Suwabe (Eraser Head in My Hero Academia ) as Florian, Ai Kayano (Mikan in Danganronpa 2 ) as Ludia, Hina Omori as Margit, Miyu Tomita (Riko in Made in Abyss ) as Monica, and Sho Hayami (Sosuke in Bleach ) as Bernhard.

The anime adaptation of Firehead’s original series will be produced by Studio Teddy, an independent anime studio founded in 2014. A relatively newer studio, Teddy previously produced the main animation for I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level Season 2, with Mercedes and the Waning Moon being their first original animation project, but the studio has worked on a number of heavy-hitting anime series in a smaller capacity.

These other projects include key animation on Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2, key animation across multiple entries in the JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure franchise, and animation assistance on Sailor Moon Crystal . If that weren’t promising enough that Mercedes and the Waning Moon is going to be a hit, the director for the series is none other than Kunihisa Sugishima, best known for his work on Yu Gi Oh! Duel Monsters , as well as storyboarding credits on Code Geass and Higurashi .

Where To Find Mercedes and the Waning Moon

Mercedes and the Waning Moon will officially release as part of the Winter 2027 Anime season on Sundays beginning on January 10, 2027. As of writing, there is currently no official announcement when a global streaming service like Crunchyroll or HIDIVE will be picking up the anime to stream for global audiences. However, the original light novel series has been picked up and localized for English-speaking audiences by J-Novel Club. Available digitally under the title Mercedes and the Waning Moon: The Dungeoneering Feats of a Discarded Vampire Aristocrat , the first four volumes of the series are currently available directly through the publishers site for purchase as an e-book.

Originally a web novel written by Firehead that was uploaded to Shosetsuka ni Naro between 2018 to 2022, the Mercedes and the Waning Moon was eventually picked up for a print release by TO Books who collected the series into light novels and began publishing the books in 2021. The series is still ongoing, and has a manga adaptation that condenses the story into a graphic novel format. The manga is also available in English through J-Novel Club.

As of writing, even before the anime adaptaiton makes its official debut, Mercedes and the Waning Moon has an extremely impressive 200,000 copies in circulation. But how do you like the look of the new anime so far? Let us know your thoughts about it in the comments!

contentBlocks.text: Vampires have been making a major comeback in popular media in recent years, with films, games, and anime reinventing the nocturnal blood-suckers to bring them back into the limelight. 2027 is ramping up to be a big year for the gothic creatures, with vampire-themed anime like Otaku Vampire’s Love Bite and The Record of a Fallen Vampire set to release throughout the year. Joining them is a brand-new series from Studio Teddy, the anime adaptation of Mercedes and the Waning Moon , an original series by Firehead that marries the concepts of isekai adventure with the romantic appeal of vampirism.

Mercedes and the Waning Moon is a unique spin on the isekai genre, taking a disgruntled, unnamed reincarnated individual and giving them a second chance at life as a vampire named Mercedes Grunewald, a descendant of vampire nobility forced to live in the countryside with her mother due to bad blood between her father. Unsure of her future or position in their house’s line of succession, Mercedes instead becomes a professional dungeon crawler. In anticipation for the anime’s January release and kicking off the new year, the anime adaptation revealed a stunning new trailer and promotional art you can find below.
Mercedes and the Waning Moon Promises Vampiric Romanticism With Isekai Adventure

The newly revealed trailer and key visual for Mercedes and the Waning Room depicts the titular Mercedes wielding her signature battle axe while surrounded by shattered glass teasing other characters that appear throughout the series. The main voice cast for the anime was also shared, which includes a star-studded cast consisting of Anna Nagase (Akane in Akane-banashi ) as Mercedes, Kenta Miyake (All Might in My Hero Academia ) as Benkei, Ryunosuke Watanuki (Okuhito in Blue Lock ) as Kuro, Junichi Suwabe (Eraser Head in My Hero Academia ) as Florian, Ai Kayano (Mikan in Danganronpa 2 ) as Ludia, Hina Omori as Margit, Miyu Tomita (Riko in Made in Abyss ) as Monica, and Sho Hayami (Sosuke in Bleach ) as Bernhard.

The anime adaptation of Firehead’s original series will be produced by Studio Teddy, an independent anime studio founded in 2014. A relatively newer studio, Teddy previously produced the main animation for I’ve Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level Season 2, with Mercedes and the Waning Moon being their first original animation project, but the studio has worked on a number of heavy-hitting anime series in a smaller capacity.

These other projects include key animation on Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2, key animation across multiple entries in the JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure franchise, and animation assistance on Sailor Moon Crystal . If that weren’t promising enough that Mercedes and the Waning Moon is going to be a hit, the director for the series is none other than Kunihisa Sugishima, best known for his work on Yu Gi Oh! Duel Monsters , as well as storyboarding credits on Code Geass and Higurashi .
Where To Find Mercedes and the Waning Moon

Mercedes and the Waning Moon will officially release as part of the Winter 2027 Anime season on Sundays beginning on January 10, 2027. As of writing, there is currently no official announcement when a global streaming service like Crunchyroll or HIDIVE will be picking up the anime to stream for global audiences. However, the original light novel series has been picked up and localized for English-speaking audiences by J-Novel Club. Available digitally under the title Mercedes and the Waning Moon: The Dungeoneering Feats of a Discarded Vampire Aristocrat , the first four volumes of the series are currently available directly through the publishers site for purchase as an e-book.

Originally a web novel written by Firehead that was uploaded to Shosetsuka ni Naro between 2018 to 2022, the Mercedes and the Waning Moon was eventually picked up for a print release by TO Books who collected the series into light novels and began publishing the books in 2021. The series is still ongoing, and has a manga adaptation that condenses the story into a graphic novel format. The manga is also available in English through J-Novel Club.

As of writing, even before the anime adaptaiton makes its official debut, Mercedes and the Waning Moon has an extremely impressive 200,000 copies in circulation. But how do you like the look of the new anime so far? Let us know your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Ao no Hana Utsuwa no Mori Live-Action Series Gets 2-Episode Spinoff Drama on December 21
content:
NHK announced on Tuesday that a two-episode spinoff of the live-action series based on Yuki Kodama 's Ao no Hana Utsuwa no Mori (Blue Flower, Forest of Vessels) manga, titled Ao no Hana Utsuwa no Mori Spinoff Ano Ko no Kuchibeni (Blue Flower, Forest of Vessels Spinoff: That Girl's Lipstick), will air consecutively on NHK 's "Yorudora" programming block from December 21 at 11:00 p.m. JST. The spinoff episodes will run after the main series ends with its final episode on December 17.

The spinoff series will star:

• Kentarō Maeda as Fumiya Uno (second from left in image above)

• Riko as Sayaka Yoshizaki (third from left in image above)

• Misato Ugaki as Akane (leftmost)

• Menjo Kentarō as Ichise (rightmost)

The 15-minute spinoff drama centers on Fumiya, a young artisan working at Kōyō Kiln in Hasami, a town in Nagasaki prefecture famed for its pottery. The owner tasks Fumiya to create a new piece of pottery, and he confidently makes a prototype, but the lukewarm reaction of his colleagues including Aoko (from the main series), leaves him disheartened. To cheer him up, Sayaka, another colleague of Fumiya, invites him to a jazz live performance. When they arrive at the jazz bar, Fumiya finds his senior colleagues Ichinose and Akane performing.

The main series' Yōko Izumisawa is also writing the spinoff drama's script. Motohiro Hata performs the theme song "Fragments."

Yoshihiro Fukagawa is directing the series.

The manga takes place in Hasami, a town in Nagasaki prefecture famed for its pottery, and centers on Aoko, who is a ceramics painter, and her romance with a young man named Tatsuki who visits her studio.

Kodama ( Kids on the Slope ) launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Flowers magazine in March 2018, and ended it in March 2022. Shogakukan published the manga's 10th and final compiled book volume in August 2022.

title: Dragon Ball’s Official Canon is Missing Out on One of Dragon Ball GT’s Best Ideas
content:
One of the most tragic races in the Dragon Ball universe continues to get content made about them, but only in mostly non-canon timelines , which feels like a further twist of the knife. The Tuffles deserved much more dignified storytelling because their planet was taken from them by the Saiyans. Their peaceful race mostly focused on technological advances, and didn’t go out searching for conflict. It came to their front door when King Vegeta led the Saiyans in a war to takeover the planet.

The Tuffles are canon in terms of the Dragon Ball Z anime, but by manga standards they are not. Akira Toriyama reportedly created them for the anime franchise , so it’s a half-and-half canon argument. Explaining how the Saiyans took over Planet Vegeta, this also continued one of the enduring plot points of the Dragon Ball universe that Goku, Vegeta and the rest of the Z Fighters regularly have to clean up after their evil forefathers. The rooting interest isn’t simply the Saiyans are good and their enemies are evil. Sometimes context is needed for the full story.

Dragon Ball GT’s Canon Controversy Causes Confusion

The reason the Tuffles are a difficult topic is that their largest amount of screen time took place in non-canon releases Dragon Ball GT featured the Tuffles more than any other prior release thanks to the invention of Baby. The evil parasite wanted to eradicate the Saiyans and bring about the resurgence of the Tuffles. As the most iconic villain of the Dragon Ball GT series overall, it made the fanbase zero-in on the Tuffles’ lore and history.

Dragon Ball GT was eventually confirmed to not be a part of the official canon, so it sparked even more mystery around where the Tuffles could fall in the Dragon Ball story. The race is mentioned in Dragon Ball Super as it’s revealed that the Saiyans are still living in harmony with the Tuffles in Universe 6, but their main universe story needs to come back into the canon to further expand their journey. Fans can’t wipe their memory of the Baby arc, and that’s the most extensive story in their history. The only logical route forward is to feature them in the Dragon Ball Super manga’s future.

Super Must Bring Them Back

One of the fun parts of Dragon Ball ‘s multiverse is that it provides a fresh start for many arcs. The savagery the Saiyans showed in their war with the Tuffles can’t be undone, but the Z Fighters can visit Universe 6 and learn about the race. It may even provide a way in for them to take Baby’s now non-existent mission. Even though the Saiyans from Universe 6 are allies to Universe 7, the Tuffles might see them as bullies that eliminated their brethren. Or a group of the Tuffles might decide to wage war on the Z Fighters.

Imagine what it would then be like if Vegeta had to come to grips with his father’s atrocities while simultaneously defending the innocence of the current Saiyans through this new level of context? There are numerous forks in the road that could work for this story, but it’s got to get reintroduced with the Tuffles first. Do you think the Tuffles should return to the Dragon Ball story canon in the future? Let us know in the comments.

title: Live-Action Quiztopia Series Adds 13 Cast Members
content:
Netflix unveiled 13 new cast members for Quiztopia , its eight-episode live-action series of Reiichi Sugimoto and Shinkichi Kato 's Kokumin Quiz ( National Quiz ) manga, on Monday.

The new cast members all play characters who are enthusiastic fans of the National Quiz, and include:

• Kōji Ōkura as Anko, the proprietor of a suspicious snack bar, and who moves in the background of the story.

• THE STREET BEATS band's guitarist and vocalist OKI as a regular at Anko's snack bar

• Louis Kurihara as another regular at the snack bar

• Daikichi Sugawara, Kenichirō Tanabe, Umi Yamano, Ryō Katō, Himena Irei as homeless people

• Gaku Sano as Shigeki Mizumoto, a soccer player who lost his life at the National Quiz

• Sissonne comedy duo members Jirō and Shinobu Hasegawa as regulars at a restaurant who are crazy about the National Quiz

• Yoshihiro Nozoe and Yorie Yoshimoto as workers at the restaurant

Netflix describes the story:

The story takes place in an alternate Japan where Quiztopia, a national quiz show, has become the country's supreme governing authority. Under the National Quiz Law, any contestant who survives the quiz can have virtually any wish granted by the government — wealth, fame, the death of an enemy, the erasure of a criminal record, even ownership of a national landmark. The broadcast draws enormous audiences, and even the brutal forced labor awaiting eliminated contestants is treated as entertainment in this cheerfully dystopian society. At the center of it all is KK ( Takayuki Yamada ), the show's iconic host and the public's chief provocateur — who comes into contact with a group plotting to bring down Quiztopia, setting off an incident that could awaken people consumed by this seductive nightmare.

Takayuki Yamada (live-action Densha Otoko 's "Train Man," Bakuman. 's Akira Hattori, Gintama 's Elizabeth) stars in the series as KK.

The cast includes:

• Masahiro Takashima as as Commander Murakoshi, who leads the Reward and Punishment Squad responsible for carrying out penalties determined by the quiz results

• Eiko Koike as Shoko Kamijo, the producer behind Quiztopia

• Riko Ishida as Marii, a mysterious girl intent on killing KK

• Kana Kurashina as Ayako, Mari's mother and a central figure in the story;

• Kōji Seto as Seiji Nanbara, an activist plotting Quiztopia's downfall

• Renji Ishibashi as Takeshi Gokumazawa, the Prime Minister of Japan

• Rin Kataoka

• Yuzu Aoki

• Naruki Matsukawa

• Yūki Imai

• Shunsuke Daitō

• Akira Maehara

• Hoshi no Disco

• First Summer Uika

• Keiko Horiuchi

• Toshinori Omi

Teruyuki Yoshida (live-action An Older Guy's VR First Love , My Brother’s Husband ) is directing the series, and is also co-writing the scripts with Maggy. Yasunori Nishiki is composing the music.

The series premieres on Netflix on December 17.

Sugimoto and Kato serialized the manga in Kodansha 's Morning magazine from 1993 to 1995. Kodansha published four compiled book volumes for the manga. Ohta Publishing re-released the manga in two compiled book volumes in 2001.
